about_the_game:
24 hours a day, 7 days a week – begin your career with the professional fire department in Notruf 112 – The Firefighting Simulation 3!

In the third installment of the series, the focus lies on realistically simulating the day-to-day life at a fire station. Earn new qualifications, sharpen your skills, and take on a wide variety of tasks that define the everyday routine of a professional firefighter. At any moment, an alarm can go off – and all the training you’ve done will pay off in dynamic, challenging missions.

During your 24-hour shifts, you’ll have the opportunity to improve both your technical knowledge and your physical condition. Regular training sessions boost your endurance, strength, and recovery – essential attributes to stay fully prepared for any emergency.

You’ll also complete practical drills using various firefighting tools – such as the Halligan bar – helping you handle your equipment with maximum efficiency during operations.

Your shift schedule also includes specialized training courses. Completing them successfully unlocks new operational roles – allowing you to take on specific positions at the start of each shift, such as attack squad (Angriffstrupp), hose team (Schlauchtrupp), or driver/operator (Maschinist).

Every training session, drill, and qualification directly impacts your mission performance: they determine which roles you can take on and how efficiently you carry out your duties. Your progress is tracked both in detailed shift evaluations and in your interactive character overview.

Explore a large open game world featuring various urban districts and face a wide range of emergency scenarios – from classic structure fires to serious traffic accidents. You’ll take on a specific role during each mission, based on the qualifications you've earned. Plan carefully and act precisely to protect lives and property. A dynamic day-night cycle and changing weather conditions add even more depth and variety to your experience.

In faithfully simulated 24-hour shifts, you’ll take on numerous responsibilities. In addition to unexpected emergency calls, the daily routine includes plenty of tasks – there’s always something to do around the station. A rotating duty schedule ensures variety and makes every shift feel different. Thanks to close collaboration with the professional fire department in Mülheim an der Ruhr and the technical power of Unreal Engine 5, one of Germany’s most impressive fire stations has been recreated in stunning detail and is now more interactive and explorable than ever before.

Features

  • Overview of your physical and professional attributes

  • Character overview with an interactive stat-tracking system

  • Expand your abilities through courses, exercises, and training

  • Simulation of everyday life at a professional fire station

  • Collaboration with the Mülheim an der Ruhr Fire Department

  • Open game world with different urban districts

  • Dynamic day-and-night cycle with changing weather conditions

  • 24-hour shifts with a rotating duty schedule

  • Freely explorable fire station with many daily tasks

  • Diverse missions throughout the city – from firefighting to traffic accidents

  • Detailed shift evaluation

  • Developed with Unreal Engine 5
